name: 44127 · Cleveland, OH
findings: ZIP 44127 (Cleveland) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44127 (Cleveland) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44127 (Cleveland) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
